a.text: I'll stick to our agreement: operating every round until the reserve hits 8, then taking exactly 4. The storm risk is high, but if we both take now it's a random split and probably neither of us reaches 4. Cooperating is our best shared shot. I'll tell you honestly if my plan changes.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Two rounds of the generator gets us to 8, then we each take 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
